title: Maverick-SORT: Knowledge-Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning for Pharmaceutical Smart Wave Allocation
summary: Maverick-SORT is a decision-support system for pharmaceutical warehouse wave allocation, combining a knowledge-guided deep reinforcement learning core with Streamlit dashboards for wave-allocation simulation and optimization. Its simulation_data/generate_datasets_sdv.py script uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with custom constraints to fit seed data and sample target-scale synthetic warehouse datasets for scenario simulation.
